notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» inherits the chain of prev3 (3): prev1 and prev2 open the same way and write no chain, so they are passed over; the names are taken in order, «أبيه» resolved to the name alone («إبراهيم بن هاشم»)

«من سمع» is the unnamed transmitter of prev3, taken over as written
